sourceOfTruth: packages/knowledge-hub/src/conformance/setup-pm.test.ts — the supported/excluded split of the ## Notes supported-tools claim, and the claim-line resolution three lines above it. Authority for the claim's two-half grammar is the claim line itself in both corpora (.claude/skills/pair-capability-setup-pm/SKILL.md:163 and packages/knowledge-hub/dataset/.skills/capability/setup-pm/SKILL.md:163); authority for the fail-closed convention is this file's own siblings (sectionBetween, onlyStep, citedBackReference).
s12Applicability: not-applicable — r0-1 changes no persisted workflow state, ledger transition, terminal gate or evidence identity. The producer is a markdown conformance guard over two doc corpora; it has no transition matrix, so no S12 negative family applies. Recorded rather than silently omitted.

inventory.producer: supported/excluded split of the ## Notes supported-tools claim in packages/knowledge-hub/src/conformance/setup-pm.test.ts (base lines 145-147: `const cut = claimText.indexOf('anything else')`, `supported = cut >= 0 ? slice(0,cut) : claimText`, `excluded = cut >= 0 ? slice(cut) : ''`), together with the claim-line resolution immediately above it (base lines 132-137: `skillText.slice(skillText.indexOf('## Notes'))` + `notes.length > 0`).
inputs: the normalized ## Notes supported-tools claim line of each corpus's setup-pm SKILL.md
the tool display name read from each adapter's pinned H1 (`# <Name> - Complete Implementation Guide`)
the adapter set discovered from disk (`*-implementation.md`) in each corpus
representations: adapter dirs: .pair/knowledge/guidelines/collaboration/project-management-tool/ and its dataset twin
documented command: `pnpm vitest run src/conformance/setup-pm.test.ts` from packages/knowledge-hub
consumers: the `$corpus — the Notes supported-tools line names $tool (AC-1)` it.each cases (one per adapter per corpus: 8 today, 10 with a 5th adapter)
classes: marker present, tool named in the supported half only — PASS (the real corpus today, all 4 adapters x 2 corpora)
marker present, tool named in the exclusion half only — FAIL (the AC-7 fifth-adapter contract)
marker present, tool named in neither half — FAIL (not enrolled at all)
marker present, tool named in BOTH halves — FAIL (half-enrolled: supported list updated, exclusion sentence never cleaned up)
marker ABSENT (reworded), tool named on the line — THE DEFECT: fails open, supported widens to the whole line and the exclusion half is matched as if supported
marker ABSENT (deleted), tool named on the line — same fail-open branch, reached by deletion instead of reword

no ## Notes section — `slice(-1)` widens to the file's last character, so the `notes.length > 0` guard can never fire; the class does fail closed, but on the downstream claim assertion (a coincidence: a 1-char haystack holds no claim line), not on the missing section
## Notes present, no supported-tools claim line — FAIL (guarded by the claim assertion)
interactions: adapter discovery x claim split: the marker's absence is a property of the LINE, not of a tool, so it invalidates the claim for every tool in the discovered adapter set at once — the fail-closed semantics the file's siblings already have (sectionBetween throws, the whole scoped assertion dies)

fixScopeRationale: Guard-strength: production is already correct at this head (43/43 green on the unmodified corpora, and the corpora carry no drift — the 4 shipped adapters are each enrolled in Step 2, Step 3 and the Notes supported half, with the exclusion sentence intact). r0-1 is a fail-open branch inside the GUARD, so the whole correction lands in test source, which is red-spec's surface and nobody else's. No production path can close it, hence `allowedPaths: []`: green-fix changes nothing in production, re-runs the witnesses and the tier gate, and commits GREEN above the seal.

matrix.condition: Isolated copy of f7d4eb34 (detached throwaway worktree): `gitlab-implementation.md` carrying the pinned H1 placed in BOTH adapter corpora, AND the Notes exclusion sentence's leading phrase reworded `Anything else (Jira, GitLab)` -> `Everything else (Jira, GitLab)` in both SKILL.md corpora. This is the finding's own failure case verbatim.
matrix.oracle: the `$corpus — the Notes supported-tools line names 'GitLab' (AC-1)` case for each corpus; `pnpm vitest run src/conformance/setup-pm.test.ts` in packages/knowledge-hub
matrix.expected: Both GitLab cases FAIL closed with `the Notes supported-tools claim has no "anything else" exclusion sentence to split on`; whole-file run 14 failed / 41 passed. Measured against the UNHARDENED guard at the same head and the same injection: 4 failed / 45 passed with both GitLab cases passing VACUOUSLY. The other 8 Notes cases (4 enrolled tools x 2 corpora) also fail on the marker, because marker absence is a property of the line, not of a tool.
matrix.rationale: mode: test — the witness passes against the current source (no injection) and fails against the injected regression in the isolated copy; both runs are recorded here rather than in the redTests[] entry's `observed`, which stays scoped to its single passing run.
